lines.text: Noon sun. Then a monsoon downpour. One street sign, built for both.
This is our Variable Message Display. Up to eight thousand nits, visible in direct sunlight.
Then the sky turns, and the rain comes down hard.
It is I P sixty-five weatherproof. Made for weather like this.
By evening, the roads are wet.
So someone changes the message. Update messages remotely, from the web or an app. Type it, send it, done.
Built for twenty-four seven outdoor use, on highways and in cities.
Variable Message Display, by Sytronsoft. Innovate. Develop. Deliver. Visit sytronsoft dot com.
